_meta.author: Mydde
_meta.description: Inter-application protocol declaration for core-ferule. Single source of truth for participants, event types, and routing rules.

participants.name: place-de-greve
participants.domain: Mission queue — task intake and dispatch

event_types.description: An app requests a specific action from one or more other apps.
An app broadcasts its current operational state.
An app emits a message to all participants with no specific target.
An app requests information from one or more other apps.
place-de-greve notifies that a mission has been assigned to an agent.
place-de-greve notifies that a mission has been completed.

routing.rules: Handlers are declared per participant above via `capabilities`. An event is routed to all participants that declare a matching `handle:<event_type>` capability.
routing.fallback: Unrouted events are logged. No silent drops.
routing.authority: This file is the only place where routing rules are defined. Apps do not maintain their own cross-app routing.
